items.title: Ann Rabson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 21, 2007
items.q: Hank Williams? Is that Country? Well I don’t know.

ctx.x: But yeah. Well she was — really good music to my mind, you can’t categorize it. I mean really. Hank Williams? Is that Country? Well I don’t know. You talk about blues, I mean. Yeah. Ruth Brown.
Right. Well we were talking about being stuck for material to write about.
